summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, reporting unaudited financial results for Q1 ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains no transaction, offer, or special-situation event; it is a routine earnings release. No price, premium, stake, or deal terms are present. The company simply discloses quarterly revenues of $920.7M, EV deliveries of 58,577 units, and operational highlights. This is a standard periodic report for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
